name: Coordinate Interval Capacity
definition: For a convex realization $U$ of $C$ and a concept $c$ exclusive at coordinate $i$, let $w_i(U,c)$ be the supremum of $H/L$ over fixed-outside-coordinate segments with signed $i$-magnitude ranging from $L$ to $H$ inside $U$. Let $W_i(U)$ be the minimum over exclusive concepts and let $W_i(C)$ be the supremum over all convex realizations. The empty minimum is $+\infty$.
parameters: A distinguished coordinate or, intrinsically, a distinguished $\Theta$-class.
normalization: Only coordinate $i$ varies along each interval; all other real coordinates remain fixed. All exclusive concepts use one common realization, though their outside vectors may differ.
comments: The value is invariant under signed coordinate permutations when the distinguished coordinate is transported. It does not assert simultaneous variation of several coordinates.
